challengers.justification_summary: All five refutation avenues fail: §5.2.4+§5.1 pin first-failed-rule order, rule 1 passes, rule 2 fires before rule 3 (-feature ≠ feature), AC-1 binds the row's rule id, and N3 is unreachable as a first failure for any valid expectedType.

No text pins S-rule or cross-segment evaluation order ('numbered in the order listed' fixes numbering, not evaluation); S3 applies to normalized description unconditionally so the S2/S3 collision is real; the bad-type-AND-bad-id case is covered by no vector — two competent implementers diverge observably.
